statement.p: Find the flux of the constant vector field \vec v = 3\,\mathit{\vec i}+3\,\mathit{\vec j}-4\,\mathit{\vec k} through a square plate of area 25 in the zy-plane oriented in the positive x-direction.

static.solution: d\vec A = \vec i\,dA, so only the \vec i component of \vec v contributes to the flux: \mbox{Flux } = \int_S\vec v\cdot d\vec A = \int_S(3\,\mathit{\vec i}+3\,\mathit{\vec j}-4\,\mathit{\vec k})\cdot \vec i\,dA = 3\cdot 25 = 75.
